title: Fixed Front Disc and Long Handle Stump Grinder
description: One newly authored whole fixed walk-behind stump-grinder-style exterior. Two full grounded wheels on a transverse axle carry a narrow low chassis, a faceted engine housing and separate top tank-shaped case, with two long rising handle arms joined by a complete cross grip. A forward narrow vertical disc carries twelve coarse blunt radial wear-block forms; a genuine partial thick upper arc cover leaves the lower disc profile visible. A long side drive-cover exterior links the front cutter-bearing region toward the engine, while a fixed low parking stem and full flat foot hold this empty display pose with the disc above ground. Unlike a broad transverse curved-tine soil tiller or a side-feed high-chute chipper, the defining front assembly is one narrow disc and a long offset drive enclosure. Every mesh newly authored, no old machine or wheel imported. One static model zero scenes. No stump, workpiece or operating demonstration. No sharpened teeth, cutting, grinding, rotation, engine internals, fuel system, belts, torque transfer, chip containment, guard effectiveness, human fit, stability, capacity, manufacture, engineering or safety capability made or verified. Rigging, animation and interaction not made.
